summary: The Plane of Torment is the divine realm of agony, where mortals endure endless suffering. It is ruled by the Torment Sovereign, who embodies divine punishment.
history: Formed when divine forces claimed dominion over agony and despair.
Agony Pits became caverns of eternal suffering.
Suffering Halls manifest endless trials of pain.
Torment Throne rose as the seat of the Torment Sovereign.
